dedupeText: voxel based cinematic adventure poster voxel blocky low angle ensemble cast fantasy landscape pixelated textures low angle perspective emphasizing the scale of the characters against the sky contrast between organic human forms and rigid geometric voxel elements central hero figure in vibrant pink jacket acting as the focal point foreground blocky creatures framing the bottom corners of the composition combine live action ensemble with voxel environment using low angle perspective and 3d stone typography to create a cinematic adventure aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle ensemble composition featuring live-action characters integrated into a blocky, voxel-based 3D environment with high-contrast lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic low-angle shot of a diverse group of adventurers standing on a grassy block ledge, set against a bright blue sky with cubic clouds and a blocky mountain range. The scene blends realistic human textures with stylized, geometric voxel creatures and environments.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective emphasizing the scale of the characters against the sky
Contrast between organic human forms and rigid geometric voxel elements
Central hero figure in vibrant pink jacket acting as the focal point
Foreground blocky creatures framing the bottom corners of the composition
coreInvariants: Cubic/voxel geometry for all environmental and non-human elements
Bright, saturated daylight lighting with a square-shaped sun
Characters holding blocky, pixel-textured tools or weapons

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ensemble cast arranged in a semi-circle, occupying the middle ground and scaled to appear heroic from a low vantage point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character in a bright pink jacket and the large, stone-textured title block above the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large title at the top, down through the central character, then outward to the flanking characters and foreground creatures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive bright blue sky in the upper half provides breathing room for the title and flying voxel bees.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant pink and saturated orange (character costumes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across the palette with bright, direct lighting creating sharp highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or desaturated earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear as 3D stone blocks with visible cracks and pixelated textures
Extruded depth following the perspective of the camera
Irregular, chipped edges to simulate weathered stone
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inclusion of a pixelated face or icon within the counter of a letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with high tracking to contrast the heavy 3D main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, pixelated aesthetic of the source material.
Provides the heavy weight needed for 3D extrusion effects.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle shot of five diverse adventurers in colorful modern clothing standing on a grassy voxel ledge. The background features a blocky mountain range, a square sun, and cubic clouds in a bright blue sky. Include a green pixelated creature in the bottom left and a blocky wolf in the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D stone-textured title in the upper center sky, following an upward perspective. Use a heavy blocky typeface with cracked textures and 3D depth.

verificationChecks: Are all environmental elements (clouds, sun, ground) composed of cubes?
Is the camera angle low, looking up at the characters?
Does the main title have a 3D stone texture?
Is the lighting high-contrast and bright?

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between title and characters

postGenerationChecks: Ensure characters look integrated into the voxel world
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Live Action Ensemble] with [Voxel Environment] using [Low-Angle Perspective] and [3D Stone Typography] to create a [Cinematic Adventure] aesthetic.
